title: clocks.json — the module's clock definitions (authored, never derived)
description: The sole numeric + relationship source for constraints/<TOP>.{sdc,sgdc} and for the TB primary_clock. Authored by the specification stage's Wave 1; design.md §1.6 points here and carries no table. Two obligations this schema cannot express are enforced on top of it: exactly one entry has relationship=='primary' (derive-constraints, fail-loud), and period_ns == 1000/freq_mhz per entry (the check-coverage gate).

name.description: For a non-generated clock this is also the top-level port name create_clock binds to.

freq_mhz.description: Nominal frequency in MHz. Cross-checked against period_ns (within 0.01) by the check-coverage gate.

period_ns.description: Period in ns. Reaches the TB scaffold's primary_clock.period_ns, where it is halved to build the clock generator.

relationship.description: async clocks drive set_clock_groups -asynchronous (SDC) and a distinct -domain (SGDC).

generated.description: true for a divider/PLL output with no top-level port: derive-constraints emits no create_clock for it and records a create_generated_clock-deferred-to-RTL note instead. Omitted means false.

role.description: Free text for human and agent readers. No script parses it.
